title: Content and Social Media Manager
company: The Avenue Estate Agents - Agency - Permanent
description:
Great digital marketing doesn't come from simply filling a calendar. It comes from understanding what stops the scroll, keeps people watching and brings audiences back. As Content and Social Media Manager at The Avenue, you'll have the freedom to create, test and learn while helping shape the online presence of a growing property brand and its network of partner agents.

This is a hands-on opportunity where you'll be responsible for planning, coordinating and delivering our day-to-day activity across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube. This is an opportunity to influence how a growing property brand communicates with its audience, using performance data and creative thinking to influence what The Avenue does next.

What's in it for you
- £30,000 to £35,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Hybrid and field-based working across the West Midlands.
- Genuine ownership of The Avenue's day-to-day channels and creative direction.
- Freedom to experiment with new formats, platform features, creative concepts and emerging technology.
- The chance to influence both a growing central brand and the performance of its partner agent network.
- A culture built around TEST LEARN ADAPT SCALE, where new ideas are encouraged and every test is an opportunity to learn.

Your responsibilities as Content and Social Media Manager
- Manage and execute the social media strategy across key platforms, ensuring consistent, engaging and relevant activity.
- Own the publishing calendar, schedule and day-to-day activity across key platforms.
- Create and edit Reels, TikToks, Stories, Shorts and other content, developing strong concepts, hooks and formats.
- Test different edits, Trial Reels, platform features and creative approaches, using results to decide what to develop further.
- Plan seasonal, reactive and behind-the-scenes property material, working with videographers and other creatives where higher-production support is needed.
- Repurpose existing material into multiple assets while monitoring trends, creator culture and emerging opportunities.
- Work with partner agents to identify opportunities, review performance and turn audience insights into practical recommendations.

What we're looking for in a Content and Social Media Manager
- Proven experience managing business social media channels, including planning, scheduling, publishing and campaign execution.
- Strong working knowledge of Instagram, TikTok and short-form video, including hooks, retention and storytelling.
- Confident filming and editing skills, supported by a portfolio showing work you've personally created.
- Experience interpreting social analytics and turning performance data into clear ideas and recommendations.
- Strong copywriting skills and an understanding of how content should adapt across different platforms and audiences.
- Practical experience using AI, emerging technology and new platform features to improve creative output.

Property or estate agency knowledge would be useful, but it isn't essential. The Avenue is more interested in the quality of your work, your understanding of digital platforms and the results you can demonstrate than the sector you've worked in previously.

If you want the freedom to create, experiment and influence what a growing property brand does next, apply online for the Content and Social Media Manager position with your CV and portfolio.

The Avenue would particularly like to see short-form video, accounts you've worked on, campaigns and examples of ideas you've personally helped bring to life.

title: CRM Manager - Braze
description:

You'll work collaboratively with Growth, Product and Data teams, using customer insights, innovative CRM tools and data-driven marketing strategies to deliver meaningful results. title: Digital Communications Officer
description:
Digital Communications Officer

Birmingham - Hybrid - Office based

Pro-rata £20,983 (FTE £26,229)

Hours: 30 hours per week (part time - flexible working Monday to Friday)

Contract: Fixed term - 2 years

Help us connect more people with trusted mental health information and support.

Birmingham Mind is the largest independent mental health charity in Birmingham. Since 1962, we have supported people across the city through high quality, person-centred mental health services. Our vision is Better Mental Health for All, and our values shape how we work: we celebrate people, we are better together, we inspire hope, we champion change and we bridge the gap.

We are looking for a creative, organised and values-led Digital Communications Officer to strengthen Birmingham Mind's digital presence. This is an exciting role for someone who can create engaging, accessible content, support digital campaigns and help colleagues use our website, social media channels and new staff intranet effectively.

About the role

As Digital Communications Officer, you will play a central role in developing and maintaining Birmingham Mind's digital presence. You will help design, structure and launch a new staff intranet, create and update website content, and produce digital materials that support our services, campaigns and events.

You will work closely with the Communications & Marketing Lead and colleagues across the organisation to plan and create content, keep digital channels accurate and accessible, support paid and organic campaigns, and provide guidance and training so staff and volunteers can make confident use of our digital platforms.

This is a varied and practical role for someone who enjoys turning information into clear, engaging content, collaborating with different teams and using insight and creativity to improve how people connect with Birmingham Mind.

About you

You will bring experience of creating engaging content for websites, intranets and social media, together with confidence using content management systems, digital platforms and analytics. You will be an excellent written and verbal communicator who can adapt content for different audiences while maintaining high standards of accuracy, accessibility and brand consistency.

We are particularly interested in hearing from people who can manage multiple projects and deadlines, build positive working relationships and use data and feedback to improve communications. Experience of graphic design or digital content tools, paid campaigns, accessibility standards or communications within mental health and wellbeing services would be an advantage.

Just as importantly, you will be motivated by Birmingham Mind's purpose. You will be someone who communicates with empathy, acts with integrity, values collaboration and understands the importance of person-centred, inclusive communications for people experiencing mental health difficulties.

Why join Birmingham Mind?

This is an opportunity to take on a creative role with real variety and purpose. You will help make our information and services easier to find, strengthen engagement with staff and communities, and ensure our digital communications reflect the quality, accessibility and values of Birmingham Mind.

You will join a supportive and collaborative team where your ideas, digital skills and attention to detail will help us communicate more effectively and connect more people with mental health information and support.

Staff benefits include an attractive defined contribution pension scheme, PayCare, which offers employees affordable cover for a range of healthcare treatments, an Employee Assistance Programme that includes free counselling, a cycle to work scheme, and a comprehensive training programme.

Birmingham Mind is extremely proud to have a diverse workforce that is reflective of the communities that we work with. We strongly encourage applications from individuals with lived experience of mental health challenges as their perspectives enrich our teams. We are also committed to changing the ethnic diversity of our management team and particularly encourage applicants from minority communities to apply for this role.

Candidates must have the right to work in the UK for a minimum of 12 months. We are not a registered sponsor and therefore are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Our people are key to the success of the organisation, and we are recognised as both a Mindful Employer as well as achieving Gold standard success in Investors in People. We welcome applications from people who have experienced mental health difficulties.

Closing date for applications is Sunday 1st November 2026

Interviews will take place on Monday 16th November 2026

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

Birmingham area

Hybrid working

c£40,000 - £50,000 DOE

This is an exciting, newly created Marketing Manager role joining a successful, established business with exciting and ambitious plans for growth.

As part of a newly formed Marketing, Digital and E-commerce team, you'll take ownership of marketing for a growing, multi-site B2 B and B2 C supplier. It's a broad, hands-on role covering everything from promotional campaigns and new site launches to CRM, email, social media, print and customer acquisition.

There's plenty of autonomy. You'll be encouraged to bring ideas to the table, challenge how things are done and really make your mark, while working closely with an approachable, down-to-earth Marketing Director and a talented team of marketing, digital and e-commerce peers.

The department is also embracing AI in a big way. You might already be highly skilled in modern AI marketing tools, automation and workflows, or you may have a good grounding and be excited by the opportunity to develop this further. Either way, curiosity and a genuine interest in how AI can make marketing smarter, faster and more effective will be important.

The role

You'll take ownership of a varied marketing plan supporting multiple business locations and online channels. Your remit will include:
- Planning and delivering promotional, seasonal and commercially focused marketing campaigns.
- Supporting new site openings and local marketing initiatives.
- Managing email, CRM, customer retention and reactivation campaigns.
- Overseeing organic social content and local demand generation.
- Managing brochures, leaflets, POS and other print activity from brief through to delivery.
- Working closely with operational and sales teams to understand customers and what drives sales.
- Tracking campaign performance, budgets, leads and commercial results.
- Using AI and automation tools to streamline marketing activity, improve efficiency and increase output.

This isn't a role where you'll spend all week sitting behind a desk. You'll regularly visit different business locations, engage with the people closest to the customer and use those insights to shape marketing activity.

What we're looking for

You'll be a commercially minded, hands-on marketer who enjoys taking ownership, delivering results and getting things done.

You'll bring:
- Experience in a broad marketing role, within a multi-site trade, retail, merchant or similar commercially driven environment.
- A good understanding of B2 B and B2 C marketing, customer acquisition and retention.
- Practical experience across a mix of CRM/email marketing, campaigns, social media, print and local marketing.
- Confidence interpreting marketing data, measuring performance and understanding commercial impact.
- Experience using modern marketing platforms and technology, with an interest in developing your AI and automation capabilities.
- A proactive, organised and self-sufficient approach, with strong communication skills and attention to detail.

What's on offer?

You'll be joining a growing team where there's real scope to influence how the marketing function develops. You'll have access to paid AI tools and training, supportive leadership and the freedom to test ideas and make decisions without unnecessary layers of sign-off.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, wants to be trusted to get on with their job and is excited by the prospect of helping shape a modern, forward-thinking marketing function within an ambitious and successful business.

Interested?

Please apply with an up-to-date CV that clearly demonstrates your relevant marketing skills and experience, including details of the marketing platforms, systems, AI and digital tools you've worked with.

You'll work across a small portfolio of client accounts, but a key focus of the role will be growing the agency's own organic visibility. You'll have the opportunity to test SEO ideas, improve website performance and see the impact of your work first-hand.

If you're passionate about SEO, enjoy working with clients and want to develop your experience across both agency and in-house-style SEO, this could be a great next step.

What You'll Be Doing
- Developing and delivering SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, traffic and conversions.
- Taking ownership of the agency's own SEO strategy, identifying opportunities to grow organic search performance.
- Conducting SEO audits, keyword research and performance analysis.
- Managing technical SEO, including site architecture, crawlability, indexing, redirects and other technical improvements.
- Creating and optimising SEO content, including landing pages, service pages, blogs and case studies.
- Improving on-page SEO, metadata, website copy and user experience.
- Using GA4, Google Search Console and SEO tools to identify opportunities and measure performance.
- Working with clients and internal teams to implement SEO recommendations.
- Contributing to client reporting and confidently communicating SEO results, recommendations and next steps.
- Supporting wider marketing activity with a search-first mindset, including content and social media.
- Exploring how AI search, LLM SEO and evolving search behaviour can create new opportunities.
- Sharing SEO insights, trends and best practice with the wider team.

What We're Looking For
- 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally within a digital marketing or SEO agency.
- Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO and SEO strategy.
- Experience working with lead generation and/or e-commerce websites.
- Previous client-facing experience, with the ability to build relationships and communicate SEO recommendations clearly.
- Experience using Screaming Frog, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager and SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush or Majestic.
- A commercially minded approach to SEO, with a focus on traffic, leads, conversions and business growth.
- Excellent organisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple SEO projects.
- A genuine interest in how SEO is evolving, including AI search and LLMs.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

What's On Offer
- 35,000- 40,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working - 3 days per week in a Birmingham office.
- 25 days' holiday, increasing annually.
- Birthdays off.
- Private healthcare.
- Annual wellness fund.
- Company bonus.
- MacBook Pro and an annual budget for hardware, software or accessories.
- Regular company socials.
- Excellent career progression and development opportunities.
